acquisition: For growing agents, 2 acquisition intervals of duration U(14,42)d begin uniformly within the scored180d horizon subject to fitting; repeat probability decreases by U(0.05,0.15), with probability floor0.1. Activity multiplier ramps linearly1 to U(1.1,1.8). After interval, retain resulting catchment and smoothly return demand over 7d. No label inspection.

assumption_status: Synthetic assumptions, not empirically calibrated Zimbabwe operator statistics.
customer_retention: At each 7d boundary each catchment member survives with independently drawn per-agent retention U(0.80,0.98). Replace leavers without replacement from other local wallets to maintain20 regular slots. Keep actual transaction history; membership replacement does not reset observable novelty.
local_unit: 100 wallets and 8 agents; each agent has a randomly selected initial regular catchment of 20 wallets, with overlaps allowed. Background regular-customer choice uses repeat probability; remaining choice draws from the other80 local wallets. No partition-global uniform pool.
novelty_scale_control: Exactly the same unit size, per-unit row budget, horizon, catchment rules and activity distributions for Train/Validation/Final. Independent changes composition only as declared; neither pool size nor temporal horizon changes.
ordinary_growth_audit: Retain both target states for every origin, and separately examine legitimate-growth-origin target 0. Verify failed A1 conditions and cross-family positives. No minimum/maximum growth AUC is a generation objective.

ordinary_shocks.customer_source: mixture of returning and nonregular local wallets
shift demand from another agent in same unit; total unit demand conserved

ordinary_shocks.cause: ordinary expansion / recovery after low activity
ordinary_shocks.customer_source: returning and acquired customers; no future recovery in current label

overlapping_distributions: For every archetype draw activity weight lognormal(log(median),0.6), truncated to[0.2,4]. Draw repeat probability uniformly within center +/-0.15, clipped to[0.1,0.95]. Thus distributions overlap and no latent identity implies target.
own_history: All newness is evaluated from actual agent service history, never private membership lists. Same observable history produces the same label in every archetype.
shock_allocation: Every archetype can receive each shock. Propose2 shocks per agent per scored horizon, cause uniformly from the 5 groups, continuous start time uniform over fitting interval. Seasonal archetypes additionally receive the sinusoid with amplitude U(0.1,0.4) and phase U(0,2pi); volatile archetypes receive2 additional shocks. Multiply overlapping factors then cap total activity multiplier to[0.25,3]. These caps are generator assumptions, not feature clipping.
